title: Phone: flight operations desk — twelve of twelve in Hangar 1

transcript.speaker: Flight Operations Desk
transcript.text: Devin, desk. 0800 count was twelve of twelve in Hangar 1, UAS-01 to UAS-12. Nothing on the schedule today, no keys signed out, and the hangar alarm hasn’t been unset since last night.

transcript.speaker: Flight Operations Desk
transcript.text: None of our Remote ID serials on the register is anything like that one. Do you want to call police or shall I?

voiceStyles.Flight Operations Desk: Young man, careful, reading from the register

instructorNote: The negative is provable. Watch for the time of the count and the serial comparison going to police.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Fleet Status Confirmation — Hangar 1

transcript.speaker: SOL
transcript.text: Ops, this is the Site Operations Lead. Confirming all twelve Group aircraft are grounded in Hangar 1 per the daily schedule (FOM-102) and fleet register (FOM-101). No flights were launched today. UAS-12 (RID-BM-12-004) is confirmed as ground-locked at Hangar 1. All pre-flight checklists are complete and stored on HUOG-NAS01. No anomalies in the parameter log.

snapshot.instructorNote: This call confirms fleet status and grounds the aircraft. The IC must verify the fleet register and daily schedule are synchronized. Watch for over-reliance on verbal confirmation without cross-checking the NAS.
